      upper = getOnes(numDigits + 1);
    } else {
      return numDigits;
    }
    long resLower = decompose(n % lower) + (n / lower) * getOnes(numDigits);
    long resUpper = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    if (upper - n < n) {
      resUpper = decompose(upper - n) + getOnes(numDigits + 1);
    }
    return Math.min(resLower, resUpper);

  public static long getNumOfDigits(long n) {
    return (long) Math.floor(Math.log10(n)) + 1;
  }

  public static long getOnes(long count) {
    long res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      res = res * 10 + 1;
